content: Iesu Sibo Sinai Pilate aurin
Fomenei fomenei priest aiwabis a sabu kawian engon asi bainonot on sidudurai Iesu sitasubun mes.
Osi on Iesu iman sifatumen ato sibonanawai sinai Rome yangan asi gawan wabin Pilate aurin.
Judas Irabob
Judas kaseirotin isagob Iesu on sibimakiai, on mes on ya baikitabir ibo ato agim orot kaitamom auyotoat nanaba ibo imatabir men priest aiwabis a sabu kawian auris.
On iyau, “Yau on orot obin akaseirai inarab aurin on nan abokomas!” Osi siyafotai siyau, “Ato dura wei auri on yabin ambin? Nan on om toum am yababan!”
Judas on agim tafaror goai nan irebenen ato inai; namon on inai ato toun anjon ikonatai irabob.
Priest aiwabis agim sibogagaien ato siyau, “Atonio on tara an agim, ato ot ati Baifafaro men iyau on agim on tanboai tafaror goa an didiwagai tanyein mes.”
Osi sidudur sibasitai isawar weie, osi on agim sibo Naukwat an Motob sitobon, sabu toumanis nan semama on asi rasi mes.
On yabinai ari ra min on efan wabin seyoyorai, “Tara an Motob.”
Namon aubairuruotin Jeremaiah mamaba i’yau on inat idura bag: On ato nanaba iyau, “Osi agim orot kaitamom auyotoat on sibo, on agim on Israel yangan sibasitai On sittobonai mes,
ato on agim sibo naukwat an motob sitobon, mamaba Bada dura wawaninai i’yawureu on.”
Pilate on Iesu Itetemai
Iesu on Rome yangan asi gawan nanai itawar ato gawan on ibitetemai. On itetemai iyau, “Om min Jew yangan asi Aiwab i?” Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Om dura ato u’yau on nanaba.”
Priest aiwabis a sabu kawian on Iesu siubarai, baise On men abi dura tani iyafotes on.
On mes Pilate on Iesu aurin iyau, “Atonio osi bobo engon tutufin auris sebiubarem min etatam i?”
Baise Iesu on men igogoi dura tani itikakafun, on yabinai on gawan on men sunub iduduran on.
Pilate on Iesu Itetemai Itirabobai aurin
kwanda fufur Baisobon an Forag an Ra on Rome yangan asi gawan on bobo nanaba wantoan ifofour, sabu kuayo on aurin sibifefeyanai on asi gogoi nanaba on orot tani fafatum goai imama on iboseirai i’gat.
On an werai orot bobo komasis fourenotin wabin duran gagamin, on wabin min Iesu Barabbas on fafatum goai siwan imama.
On mes sabu kuayo gagamin siruayo mom, ato Pilate itetemis iyau, “Orot menan on wogogoi anyatetai weinem? Iesu Barabbas o Iesu seyoyorai Keriso?”
Pilate isagob tiwag Jew babadis on siboboar on mes Iesu sibo on imanai siyagai.

Pilate on nana an baigurubaban an mamageai imama, ato awan jever on dura Pilate aurin ato nanaba iyafar igat iyau. “Om men bobo aifan tani ato Orot obin aurin unafour mes, yabin on Orot aurin on yau fom bomomout komasin bag ait.”
Priest aiwabis a sabu kawian on sabu kuayo gagamin sidodois osi Pilate sitifefeyanai Barabbas on ityatetai ato Iesu on itasubun.
Baise Pilate on sabu kuayo gagamin itetemis iyau, “Atonio osi orot ruam on, menan on wogogoi anyatetai weinem i?” Osi siyafotai siyau, “Barabbas!”
Pilate itetemis iyau, “Atonio Iesu seyoyorai Keriso, on mamaba anfourai i?” Osi engon tutufin siyoku siyau, “ Nabai ekubarai.”
Baise Pilate itetemis iyau, “On abi bobo komasin ifour?” Namon osi aumiet bag sibosuruf sibiyoku si’yau, “Nabai ekubarai!”

Pilate on bobo it on men fofonin arimon aifan tani itiyamai, baise arimon sabu sitigagam, on mes on sareu ibo sabu kuayo gagamin matasi nan iman isouen ato iyau, “Atonio orot an rabob aurin on yau au baibad tani ambin! Atonio on omi ami bobo!”
Sabu kuayo gagamin engon tutufin on siyafotai siyau, “On an rabob an bit on eikirir wei nanatui mat wanboai.”
Namon Pilate on Barabbas iyatetai igat weines; ato on wou yangan iyawures Iesu siyaswabirai weie on osi imasi iyagai nabai sitkubarai mes.
Wou Yangan Iesu Sikoboai
Namon Pilate an wou yangan on Iesu sibo sirui gawan an goa ann werominai nan ato wou yangan engon tutufin on nan siruayo sikukufinai.
Osi on Iesu an beber siboseseiren ato beber mururin on siyotai.

Namon osi wengar aisikis fafames on siboen nigir siyamai ato uninai siyein, ato siwa sibo iman asumaiauai nan sitai; namon osi On nanai sindas sirorouin ato sibikoboai. Osi si’yau, “Jew yangan asi Aiwab, mama wantoanin!”
Osi sikantuturai, ato siwa sibo uninai nan sirab.
Osi sikoboai isawar weie, beber mururin on siboseir ato Toun an beber on siyotai men. Namon osi sibonanawai sigat sitkubarai mes.
Iesu Nabai Sikubarai
Osi sibib si’gat ato orot wabin Simon, an tafanam Cyrene emon, on mat sinefoten, ato wou yangan sirukokouai Iesu an nab itabar mes.
Osi sinat efan wabin seyoyorai, “Golgotha, on an yabin min, “Tekwakwan An Efan.”
On nan osi sareu wine on fio tani riribin bag on mat sisutabir sititai itoman mes, baise On sareu igitobon mom ato isisiwei.
Osi Iesu sikubarai ato asi barom siyo nan sitsagob onai an beber tous sanasi sitraram bonen.
On gibunai osi nan simair ato On wat on siruruaiai.
On an ubar dura on wengar sibo nan sigayam ato unin tefanai nan wengarai sidudun: “Atonio Orot on Iesu, Jew yangan asi Aiwab.”
Namon osi sabu yakeotis ruam on Iesu mat sikubares, orot tani on an asumaiauai a orot tani on an asugagafai.
Sabu nan si’nan si’nat on Iesu aurin unis siyuyuwe ato sibikoboai si’yau,
“Om tafaror goa utgoros ato ra baitonin on utyon men! Om God Natun on Toum eiyawasim tait! Nab emon esur!”
On eta kaitamomai priest aiwabis a Baifafaro an baibebeotis a sabu kawian on Iesu sikoboai si’yau:
“On sabu fani ibiyawasis, baise On Toun on men fofonin iniyawasai on! On min Israel yangan asi Aiwab? On ari nab emon insur on, ot On tanitutumai!
On God ebitutumai ato Toun eyoyorai God Natun. Basit, tanitai God ingogoi mes on ari iniyawasai!”
A sabu yakeotis Iesu mat sikubares on osi mat on dura kaitamomai aurin sikakafun.
Iesu Irabob
Wera aiyet nanaba tafanam engon tutufin iwouman, inai wera ton isawar.
Ibirabirabi wera ton nanaba Iesu on aumiet bag iyor iyau, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” On an yabin min, “Au God, au God, Om aibo mes uikirireu?”
Sabu fani nan sitatawar on sitatamai ato siyau, “On Elijah aurin eyoyor!”
Osi sabu sanasi orot tani ra kaita iyayai inai beber samisamin ibo, onai nan sareu wine riribin ikutub ato siwa kanfounai iyein ato iyotogai ifourtobon itiyamai ittoman mes.
Baise sabu fani siyau, “Om emousin, tait Elijah enat iniyawasai ai ambin!”
Iesu aumiet iwaf men ato irabob.
Namon tafaror goa amonai beber iroror on isafef ruam simatar, tefanai isur inai babanai igat. Motob iyuyun, agim sitasesebis,
rasi dogu awas siruserenen, ato God an sabu sigaraba ainau sirabob nono on simisiririn siyawas.
Osi asi rasi dogu sikiriren ato gibui Iesu rabob emon imimisir on engon sinai mafam gagamin kakafaiinai, nan sabu sigaraba sites.
Wou yangan asi orot gagamin a wou yangan mat nan sitawar Iesu sibimateteai on sit uruyoi a bobo fani simatar, ato osi siber kwakwan siyau, “On dura bag God Natun!”
Jever sigaraba on nan, nanenei sitawar siruruai, osi on Galilee emon sinat ato Iesu sibaisin.
Osi jever sanasi on Mary Magdalene a Mary, James a Joseph rus ayos, a Zebedee awan.
Iesu Sigarobai
Ibirabirabi, orot sawarotin an mafam Arimathea emon on inat; on orot wabin min Joseph, ato on orot mat min Iesu an baigibubunuotin tani.
On irui Pilate nanai itawar Iesu usin boin aurin on ifefeyanai. Pilate dura wawaninai wou yangan iyawures Iesu usin sitboai Joseph sititai.
On mes Joseph on Iesu usin ibo ato beber kakakaiin bobounai ikiman,
ato on an rasi dogu on nan iwan, on dogu on ato arimon agim wawanin amonai nan isar. Namon on agim gagamin on ifiruruai irabon dogu awan iyafotai ato on inai.
Mary Magdalene a Mary tani on nan simair simama rasi dogu wat on sibimateteai.
Rasi Dogu Awan Sikakaifarai
Ra itom on Sabat ra, ato priest aiwabis a Pharisee yangan on Pilate mat siruayo
ato siyau, “Bada, wei wanonosin baisigogo’otin yawasin imama an rai on iyau, ‘Yau ra ton gibunai on arimon anmisir men.’

On mes om dura wawaninai unawures On an rasi on sinkakaifarai tiwag inan ra ton insawar, onai On an baigibubunuotis on men fofonin sinan usin sinbainau on, ato osi sabu sinawures sinau, On rabob emon imisir men. Atonio baisigogo dura gibui on arimon inarat kwakwan men baisigogo dura ainauin ba.”
Pilate iyawures iyau, “Sabu kaifarotis fani woboes ato wonan rasi dogu wonkaifarai tiwag.”
On mes osi sinai ato rasi dogu awan siyamai tiwag uram sibo siwar fotai ato sabu fani nan sikirires sikakaifarai.
